sports.headline: LIV Golf files Chapter 11 plan to liquidate, with a final hearing set for January
sports.summary: LIV Golf has filed a bankruptcy plan for an orderly wind-down. It says no viable restructuring remains because players did not commit and BC Partners ended its $300m financing agreement. The Saudi PIF, the league's biggest creditor, spent more than $5bn on LIV, and unsecured creditors face about $100m in claims against a $2m recovery pool. A hearing on Nov. 24 would conditionally approve the disclosure statement, and a final hearing is proposed for Jan. 7.

sports.headline: Sabalenka and Andreeva win WTA Finals openers, setting up a Group 2 decider
sports.summary: Aryna Sabalenka, now ranked world No. 2, beat Karolina Muchova 7-6(2) 7-5. French Open champion Mirra Andreeva, 19, beat Elina Svitolina 6-4 6-0 on her tournament debut. The two meet on Wednesday for control of the group. This is a tournament-state item rather than a score-only report, and it is weaker than the LIV story.

marketing.headline: Ogilvy and CAA launch ECHO, an AI platform for consent-based celebrity and athlete advertising
marketing.summary: Ogilvy, working with WPP and CAA, has launched ECHO. It turns a single celebrity or ambassador shoot into 30–50 localised ad assets using likenesses licensed through the CAA Vault. Talent must approve every asset, and finished work carries an 'Approved | Recreated with AI' label. ECHO is available across the WPP network now. It is a significant shift for how endorsement-led campaigns are produced.

marketing.headline: Margot Robbie's Papa Salt gin creates its first global marketing role
marketing.summary: Papa Salt Coastal Gin, co-founded by Margot Robbie, has hired Richard Pilbeam as global marketing director in a newly created role. He will lead brand strategy as the gin expands from Australia into the UK and other markets. The brand sold more than 46,000 bottles last year. It is a smaller-scale leadership move, included for the celebrity-brand angle.
